chapters.title: Power BI alerts are like Clippy

takeaways: Classic Power BI alerts only work on card-style visuals pinned to dashboards, which creates dashboard clutter and governance sprawl.
Custom PowerShell alert scripts are brittle; if you keep them, document them, centralize credentials and test them regularly.
Fabric Data Activator links data rules to actions such as Power Automate flows, but confirm availability in your tenant and pilot it on one business process first.
hook: Power BI alerts force admins to build dashboards and card visuals they never wanted, and custom scripts only add fragile workarounds. This episode shows Power BI and Fabric admins how Fabric Data Activator turns data thresholds into real workflows, and how to pilot it safely.
